verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure: quote, attribution, CTA and logo sit on one clean left edge, and the bottle stays inside its circle on the right. It is barely rearranged, though, and leaves loose empty space at the top and bottom, but nothing is broken. B breaks the design apart. The serum bottle is pulled out of its circle and shrunk into the bottom-left corner. The attribution and an oversized CTA sit on the empty circle, top right, away from the quote. The logo is blown up to compete with the headline. The circle is cut off at the right edge, so the reading order is jumbled and the hierarchy is wrong.
